hostParity.note: Per-namespace parity verdicts from bitty #1303 (CTX-0707) with services re-wired by bitty #1391 (CTX-0767, LUA-OQ-8): keymaps.suggest and tasks.spawn/cancel are WIRED bridge captures; services.get/provide are WIRED to the host backend (shape checks, manifest-gated provide capture, deterministic resolution, typed E_SERVICE_* failures); env.get/has stay DEFERRED (grant-gated, backend-absent denial without env.read grants); process.spawn is v1-OUT (see exclusions). bitty #1563/#1573 (CTX-0894/CTX-0897) WIRED the read-only bitty.debug backend (inspect gated on debug.inspect, trace/trace_get gated on debug.trace) while debug.control stays DEFERRED (always E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, see functions). bitty #1584 (CTX-0889, ADR-0014) WIRED bitty.workspace (list gated on workspace.read; focus/new/next/close/rename/move_panel gated on workspace.control and only enqueue a bounded request) and the workspace.* observation events, delivered only to workspace.read holders; the Lua spellings are host candidates pending OQ-056. bitty #1591 (CTX-0907) only adds plugin-host-side workspace event publication and moved no Lua verdict. bitty #1604 (CTX-0906, DIR-030) moved no verdict: Core removed the embedded network Cargo feature and Lua network binding, network access is the out-of-process net native component, and its Lua request surface is deferred and not wired, so bitty.network stays excluded. Re-verified at bitty main 2cb49afe.

types.name: BittyCommandHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned handle returned by bitty.commands.register.

types.name: BittySubscriptionHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned handle returned by bitty.events.subscribe.

types.name: BittyKeymapHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned handle returned by bitty.keymaps.suggest.

types.name: BittyServiceHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned handle returned by bitty.services.provide.

types.name: BittyBlockHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned block_id returned by bitty.ui.mount and accepted by bitty.ui.update.

types.name: BittyTaskHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned task handle returned by bitty.tasks.spawn; invalid after generation disposal.

types.name: BittyTimerHandle
types.doc: Opaque generation-owned timer handle returned by bitty.timers.create; invalid after generation disposal.

types.name: BittyJsonSchema
types.doc: Bounded JSON Schema fragment as accepted by the CLI Contract RFC and ADR 0009: depth at most 16, bounded string fields, explicit additionalProperties flag, at most CMD_SCHEMA_MAX_BYTES (16 KiB) per schema, no remote $ref, and no unbounded patterns.

types.name: BittyCommandDef
types.doc: Command registration definition for bitty.commands.register; valid only during init.lua activation.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Plugin-local command segment matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$; the host qualifies it to <plugin-id>:<id>.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Bounded display text; host-rendered, never markup.

fields.name: args_schema
fields.doc: Argument schema validated by the host before dispatch.

fields.name: result_schema
fields.doc: Result schema validated by the host before the result is returned.

fields.name: run
fields.doc: Command body; args is a plain table already validated against args_schema.

types.name: BittyCommandsNamespace
types.doc: Command registration surface (L1). Registration is valid only while init.lua executes.

types.name: BittyEventName
types.doc: Closed v1 event-name set; subscribing to an undeclared or unknown name is a registration error, and declaring any workspace.* name requires a granted workspace.read capability at activation.

types.name: BittyEmptyPayload
types.doc: Event payload with no fields for lifecycle, signal, and coalescable observation events.

types.name: BittyTerminalOpenedPayload
types.doc: terminal.opened payload delivering the accepted identity tuple.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Registry generation that allocated the terminal; lets consumers detect stale identities.

types.name: BittyTerminalClosedPayload
types.doc: terminal.closed payload; emitted once per terminal as a cold-path event.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Bounded closed reason derived from the accepted TerminalClosed shape.

types.name: BittyTerminalTitleChangedPayload
types.doc: terminal.title-changed payload with attribution.

types.name: BittyTerminalCwdChangedPayload
types.doc: terminal.cwd-changed payload with attribution; treat cwd as sensitive-capable display data.

types.name: BittyFocusChangedPayload
types.doc: focus.changed payload; coalescable.

fields.name: terminal_id
fields.doc: Attached terminal identity when the focused view has one.

types.name: BittySelectionChangedPayload
types.doc: selection.changed payload; coalescable and carries no selection text in v1.

fields.name: terminal_id
fields.doc: Attached terminal identity when the view has one.

types.name: BittyProcessExitedPayload
types.doc: process.exited payload carrying the accepted exit-status field.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceEventPayload
types.doc: workspace.closed, workspace.changed, and workspace.focused payload: identity only, never terminal content; delivered only to workspace.read holders and coalesced per host tick.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceNamedEventPayload
types.doc: workspace.created and workspace.renamed payload: identity plus the bounded display name; delivered only to workspace.read holders.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name, bounded by Core to 32 characters.

types.name: BittyInterceptPayload
types.doc: Interception payload with bounded sanitized metadata; rewriting content is not expressible.

fields.name: preview
fields.doc: Bounded sanitized preview; intercept.paste never carries paste text without clipboard.read.

types.name: BittyEventPayload
types.doc: Union of the closed v1 event payload shapes.

types.name: BittyEvent
types.doc: Immutable bounded event envelope delivered to subscribed handlers.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Event name from the closed v1 set.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Immutable payload copy, never a live core object.

types.name: BittyEventHandler
types.doc: Observation and lifecycle return values are ignored; interception handlers return the literal false to veto and any other value (including nil) to approve, so the shared handler result domain is any.

types.name: BittyEventsNamespace
types.doc: Event subscription surface (L1). Subscriptions must match manifest-declared event types.

types.name: BittyKeymapSuggestion
types.doc: Key-binding suggestion for bitty.keymaps.suggest; suggestions never override user or workspace mappings.

fields.name: chord
fields.doc: Chord in the shipped configuration grammar: trimmed, case-insensitive modifiers joined with + (ctrl, alt, shift, super); single-character keys require a modifier.

fields.name: command
fields.doc: Qualified name of a command registered by the same generation.

fields.name: when
fields.doc: v1 context; must be absent or "global", any other value is a registration error.

types.name: BittyKeymapsNamespace
types.doc: Key-binding suggestion surface (L1); suggestions are declarations with no forced mutation.

types.name: BittySettingsValue
types.doc: Plugin settings value; typed schema, merge, and reload semantics are owned by the accepted Configuration Model RFC.

types.name: BittySettingsNamespace
types.doc: Plugin settings surface (L1); keys are dot paths relative to plugins.<owner>.<name> only.

types.name: BittyStoreValue
types.doc: JSON-compatible plain data: depth at most 8, at most 1024 nodes, at most 8 KiB serialized (STORE_MAX_VALUE_BYTES); functions, metatables, cycles, and non-finite numbers are rejected.

types.name: BittyStoreNamespace
types.doc: Quota-bounded persistent key-value area scoped to the plugin id and persisted across generations; STORE_QUOTA_BYTES default 256 KiB.

types.name: BittyNotifyPayload
types.doc: Notification payload gated by platform.notify and subject to host rate policy.

types.name: BittyNotifyNamespace
types.doc: Notification surface (L1) gated by platform.notify.

types.name: BittyEnvNamespace
types.doc: Environment read surface (L1) accepted by ADR 0006. This sub-table is absent unless the manifest declares an env.read:<KEY> capability; when declared but not granted its functions fail closed with E_CAPABILITY_DENIED and never enumerate keys.

types.name: BittyServiceGetOpts
types.doc: Consumer-side service resolution options for bitty.services.get.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Version requirement in the accepted grammar, for example ">=2.0". Required: the accepted RFC defines no default requirement.

fields.name: optional
fields.doc: When true, a missing provider returns nil instead of failing with E_SERVICE_RESOLUTION.

types.name: BittyService
types.doc: Plain service table whose members are functions; calls are schema-validated by the host and return plain values, never cross-VM handles.

types.name: BittyServicesNamespace
types.doc: Service consumer and provider surface (L1); provider declarations live in the manifest [services.provided] table form.

types.name: BittyUiSlot
types.doc: Accepted closed slot set. tabline is an exclusive claim; status components compose; overlay is non-focusable presentation content. The host presents top, bottom, left, right, and statusline; tabline, overlay, and terminal have no host surface yet and ui.mount rejects them with E_UI_UNAVAILABLE.

types.name: BittySceneNode
types.doc: Bounded declarative component table shaped by the accepted SceneNode contract; v1 accepts Text, Row, Column, and List subtrees only. Exact table encoding is owned by the accepted Rich Presentation RFC.

types.name: BittyUiNamespace
types.doc: Declarative UI contribution surface (L2); rich content requires ui.rich and the overlay slot requires ui.overlay.

types.name: BittySnapshotOpts
types.doc: Terminal snapshot options; only the semantic scope is accepted in v1.

fields.name: terminal_id
fields.doc: Target terminal; defaults to the focused view's attached terminal and requires terminal.semantic-read.

types.name: BittyCellColor
types.doc: Color value: "default", a palette index 0..255, or an "#RRGGBB" string.

types.name: BittyCellAttrs
types.doc: Non-default cell attributes carried by a snapshot span; false boolean flags are omitted.

types.name: BittyCellSpan
types.doc: Half-open column range [start, end) carrying only non-default attributes.

types.name: BittySnapshotRow
types.doc: One visible snapshot row with its semantic spans.

types.name: BittySnapshotCursor
types.doc: Cursor position within the snapshot region.

types.name: BittySnapshotModes
types.doc: Bounded mode flags reflected by the snapshot.

fields.name: alternate_screen
fields.doc: Whether the alternate screen is active; zones may be absent while true.

types.name: BittyZoneKind
types.doc: Semantic zone kinds derived from committed terminal state (OSC 7/133); unknown covers terminals without shell integration.

types.name: BittyZoneRange
types.doc: Line range of a semantic zone.

types.name: BittyZoneMetadata
types.doc: Bounded untrusted zone metadata; values are never expanded or executed.

types.name: BittySemanticZone
types.doc: Semantic zone in a terminal snapshot.

types.name: BittyTerminalSnapshot
types.doc: Read-only semantic snapshot of the visible viewport; a serialized snapshot over SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES (256 KiB) is rejected with E_SNAPSHOT_TOO_LARGE rather than truncated.

fields.name: snapshot_generation
fields.doc: Terminal damage generation reflected by the snapshot.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Grid columns in the snapshot region.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Grid rows in the snapshot region.

types.name: BittyTerminalNamespace
types.doc: Read-only terminal observation surface (L2) gated by terminal.semantic-read; there is no write path to grid, cursor, modes, or scrollback in v1.

types.name: BittyTasksNamespace
types.doc: Host-owned task surface (L1) capped at 64 live tasks per plugin; exceeding the cap fails with E_BUDGET_TASK and never queues silently.

types.name: BittyTimersNamespace
types.doc: Host-owned one-shot timer surface (L1) capped at 32 live timers per plugin; exceeding the cap fails with E_BUDGET_TIMER.

types.name: BittyDebugInspectTarget
types.doc: bitty.debug.inspect target; panels is reserved and fails closed with E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, and any other string is E_DEF_INVALID.

types.name: BittyDebugPluginState
types.doc: Stable lowercase lifecycle label; failed never carries the failure message.

types.name: BittyDebugPluginRow
types.doc: One plugins inspect row, sorted by id.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Activation generation (0 before the first activation).

types.name: BittyDebugCommandRow
types.doc: One commands inspect row, sorted by plugin, id, title.

types.name: BittyDebugEventRow
types.doc: One events inspect row (an event subscription), sorted by plugin, kind.

types.name: BittyDebugInspectResult
types.doc: bitty.debug.inspect result; never includes settings values, store contents, secrets, or terminal content.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Rows for the target, capped at 1024 items; grants yields the caller's own sorted capability ids only.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: Whether rows were cut at the item cap.

types.name: BittyDebugTraceHandle
types.doc: Positive monotonic trace handle returned by bitty.debug.trace; never reused, dropped with the owning generation.

types.name: BittyDebugTraceOpts
types.doc: bitty.debug.trace options; unknown keys, wrong types, and out-of-range values are E_DEF_INVALID.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: true (default) opens a new trace; false closes the trace named by handle.

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: Exact topic, or a prefix when the pattern ends with a single *; 1..128 printable ASCII bytes; rejected with enabled = false.

fields.name: max_events
fields.doc: Drop-oldest ring size, 1..10000 (default 1000); rejected with enabled = false.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc: Required with enabled = false and rejected otherwise.

types.name: BittyDebugTraceRecord
types.doc: One recorded event, redacted for the trace owner's own grants.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: Milliseconds on a monotonic host clock (no wall clock).

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Event payload, replaced by { truncated = true, bytes = <n> } when its encoded size exceeds 4096 bytes.

types.name: BittyDebugTraceDrain
types.doc: Drained trace buffer returned by bitty.debug.trace_get; draining empties the buffer.

fields.name: dropped
fields.doc: Records lost to drop-oldest since the previous drain; resets after being reported.

types.name: BittyDebugNamespace
types.doc: Devtools inspection surface; each entry point needs its own grant (debug.inspect, debug.trace, debug.control) with no implication between them. Host-implemented spellings; not part of the ADR 0009 v1 guarantee.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceId
types.doc: Positive stable workspace id (Core creation sequence); survives index shifts and is never reused for another workspace.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceAttention
types.doc: Attention flags of one workspace; the host reports every flag false until Core grows a per-workspace attention source.

fields.name: bell
fields.doc: A bell rang since the workspace was last focused.

fields.name: activity
fields.doc: Output arrived while the workspace was inactive.

fields.name: exited
fields.doc: A panel process in the workspace exited.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceInfo
types.doc: One bitty.workspace.list row: identity, order, and structure only, never terminal content.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Whether this is the active workspace.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceIndexTarget
types.doc: Positional bitty.workspace.focus target.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: 1-based position, clamped to the last workspace like the Alt+N binding.

types.name: BittyWorkspaceNamespace
types.doc: Workspace domain (L1, ADR 0014): list is gated on workspace.read; every mutation is gated on workspace.control only (read never implies control), enqueues into a bounded host queue (32 requests per tick), and returns whether it was queued, not applied. Spellings are host candidates pending OQ-056.

functions.doc: Registers a plugin command; valid only during init.lua activation. The qualified name must already be reserved in the manifest [lazy].commands, duplicate qualified names are rejected at graph construction, and a later registration attempt is a registration error.

Subscribes to one closed v1 event name; the type must be declared for the plugin. Observation and lifecycle handler results are ignored; interception handlers return false to veto, anything else to approve.

Suggests a key binding for a command registered by the same generation; the accepted precedence user > workspace > first-party/default > plugin always applies and conflicts produce diagnostics for user resolution.
Reads a key relative to plugins.<owner>.<name>; plugins cannot read outside their own namespace.
Writes a key relative to plugins.<owner>.<name>; plugins cannot write outside their own namespace.
Reads a persisted value by key; keys match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ and the store survives suspension, reload, and generation disposal.
Writes or, with nil, deletes a persisted value; writes are synchronous and fail closed on value invalidity or quota overflow without partial writes.
Shows a host-rendered notification via the platform.notify capability, subject to host rate policy.

Reads a desensitized environment value for a bounded ASCII key matching ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (1..64); keys outside the allowlist return nil, indistinguishable from an unset variable. Available only when the namespace is declared.
Reports presence without exposing the value beyond the trace surface. Available only when the namespace is declared.

Resolves a provider before activation; a missing provider fails closed with E_SERVICE_RESOLUTION unless opts.optional is true, and provider disappearance makes in-flight calls fail closed with E_SERVICE_GONE.

Provides an interface implementation during activation; the interface, version, and bounded schemas must already be declared in the manifest [services.provided] table form, and arguments and results are schema-validated by the host.

Mounts declarative component content into an accepted semantic slot; rich content requires ui.rich, the overlay slot additionally requires ui.overlay, and the exclusive tabline slot requires a matching [lazy].claims entry (E_UI_CLAIM_REQUIRED). After those gates, an accepted slot the host does not present (tabline, overlay, terminal) fails closed with E_UI_UNAVAILABLE (runtime). Host layout owns placement and decoration, and there are no global coordinates, shaders, pipelines, glyph injection, native windows, or renderer handles.

Replaces a block's scene subtree under the same block_id with an incremented version; returns false for a stale or foreign handle and raises E_UI_COMPONENT_INVALID for a component that violates the scene contract.
Returns a read-only semantic snapshot of the visible viewport; only the semantic scope is accepted in v1 and there is no raw scope, scrollback, or full-grid selection.
Spawns a host-owned task wrapping a Lua continuation; handles are generation-owned and all generation N handles fail closed after disposal.
Cancels a task cooperatively at the next host slice; cancellation releases the cap slot and there is no Lua-visible abort hook in v1.
Creates a generation-owned one-shot timer; repeating timers are a 1.x minor addition.
Cancels a timer and releases the cap slot; handles from a disposed generation fail closed.

Read-only runtime inspection returning { target, items, truncated }; a non-string target is E_DEF_INVALID before the grant check, the reserved panels target fails closed with E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, and other plugins' grants are never exposed.

Opens (nil or enabled = true) or closes (enabled = false with handle) an event trace; a trace records only event kinds the plugin declares in [lazy].events, intersected with filter, at most 4 traces per plugin (E_DEF_LIMIT), and closing an unknown or foreign handle is E_DEF_INVALID.
Drains a trace owned by this plugin; a non-integer handle is E_DEF_INVALID, and an unknown or foreign handle returns nil so other plugins' traces cannot be probed.

High-risk lifecycle control (reload_plugin, suspend_plugin, resume_plugin, clear_state by plugin id); non-string arguments are E_DEF_INVALID, and the host fails closed before reading the grant or the target.
Lists workspaces in order, at most 16 rows (the Core MAX_WORKSPACES bound); names are truncated to 32 characters and rows never carry terminal content.
Queues focusing a workspace by positive stable id or by { index = n } (1-based); an id that no longer exists at apply time is dropped fail-closed.
Queues creating a workspace and switching to it, subject to the Core capacity bound.
Queues switching to the next workspace (wraps).
Queues closing a workspace (nil closes the active one) through the kill-confirm gate: idle workspaces close immediately and live ones arm the user confirmation.
Queues renaming a workspace; name must be a non-blank UTF-8 string without control characters and at most 256 bytes (E_DEF_LIMIT), and Core truncates accepted names to 32 characters.
Queues moving the focused panel of the active workspace into the workspace with this stable id.

exclusions.reason: No bitty.api alias namespace; the module root is bitty and there is one spelling per concept.
Flat command spelling rejected; the accepted spelling is bitty.commands.register.
Flat event spelling rejected; the accepted spelling is bitty.events.subscribe.
Flat terminal spelling rejected; the accepted spelling is bitty.terminal.snapshot.
Panel providers are post-v1.0; bitty.ui.mount contributes declarative slot content only.
No filesystem entry point in v1; fs.* grants remain a separate capability path.
No process entry point in v1.

No network entry point in v1. Core removed the embedded Lua network binding (bitty #1604, DIR-030); network access is the out-of-process net native component, and its Lua request surface (non-blocking handle plus response event) is deferred and not wired.
No clipboard entry point in v1; intercept.paste never carries paste text without clipboard.read.
No IPC entry point in v1.
No renderer handle in v1; the renderer stays replaceable.
Level 4 protocol registration is excluded; no OSC/APC handler registration.
Level 3 presentation is excluded in v1.
Level 3 presentation is excluded in v1.
Level 3 presentation is excluded in v1.
Singular task namespace rejected; the accepted spelling is bitty.tasks.
Singular timer namespace rejected; the accepted spelling is bitty.timers.
Level 4 protocol registration is excluded in v1.

W-139 (CTX-0066) history/search/selection surface is blocked: the delegating W-135 (bitty-terminal-docs search-selection-contract), W-137 (bitty-plugins-docs history-and-storage-policy), and W-138 (bitty-plugins-docs search-copy-mode-policy) contracts are draft and authorize no implementation, and no accepted closed-set capability covers scrollback or history text read. The Plugin Platform RFC fixes the terminal family as terminal.semantic-read/raw-read/input.self/input.all/manage, and the accepted Plugin API v1 Lua Surface RFC states v1 has no scrollback text read path; adding a scrollback/history read capability requires a successor RFC with its own security review. Re-evaluate when an accepted capability and a bitty host entry point exist.

excludedArgumentLiterals.reason: The raw snapshot scope is explicitly excluded from v1; only semantic is accepted.
